name: Angelo
master_origin: Raster artwork made with an image-generation model and cut out onto a transparent background; packaging never redraws or recolours it
design: Curious teal raven robot head in a three-quarter view with a slight head tilt: a rounded teal-to-seafoam helmet with a swept feather crest, a dark charcoal visor with two mint-white capsule eyes, and a short coral beak
vector_usage: Path-based reductions for native toolbar, wordmark and Wayland only; app icons use the approved transparent PNG.

wordmark.letter_a: Triangular A (100 x 88 units) with an even-odd counter, clipped into five teal facets #a1f4d6, #27bdbf, #1aa3ad, #0b8a99, #087787 over a #1aa3ad base layer; the white variant keeps the facet order as opacity
wordmark.letters: ngelo in the project's variable Inter (release/datafiles/fonts/Inter.woff2) at weight 500, optical size 32 and -0.015 em letter spacing, as in the approved source; outlined to paths in angelo-wordmark-letters.svg by build_files/utils/angelo_letters.mjs
wordmark.letter_l: Deliberate substitution: plain stem (no tail, as in web Inter's default l) with the weight-500 stem's left edge, width and ascender, flush with the baseline and symmetric side bearings; the bundled Inter only has a tailed l
wordmark.layout: A height 0.76 em standing on the baseline, 0.02 em gap before n; same mark and letter placement as the previous lockup
